_readme: Merged into ~/.codex/hooks.json by aos sync ({{aos}} = this repo's aos.psm1, {{root}} = the repo). Entries containing 'aos guard' or 'aos-notes.mjs' are owned by aos and replaced on every sync; trust them once in Codex (/hooks).

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex pre-edit"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex pre-edit"

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex session-start"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex session-start"

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex session-end"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module '{{aos}}' -DisableNameChecking; aos guard codex session-end"
